note: The owner's copy rule for every post, page and card (2026-10-09): report, do not promote. No price talk, no promises, no calls to buy, no 'coming soon', no hype punctuation. The draft script lints every template before printing and refuses on a hit; `scripts/burnkeeper-post-draft.mts lint <text|file>` lints anything else. Patterns are JavaScript regexes applied case-insensitively after the ALLOWED spans are masked out. References: docs/launch/x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules; src/lib/burnKeeper/statusPage.ts COPY RULE (SPEC §9.2); docs/launch/daily-post.md § Lint.

price-returns.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: 'Nothing about price, ever'; SPEC §9.2
price-returns.why: a report says what supply did; it never says what price did or does

promises.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: no promises; x-threads.md header
promises.why: the rule is the only promise; everything else is a report of what already happened

calls-to-buy.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: 'Never a call to buy'
calls-to-buy.why: trade links live on the pages, not in posts

urgency.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: no countdowns to a listing, no urgency
urgency.why: urgency is a sales device; receipts have no deadline

hype-punctuation.why: three exclamation marks or a rocket is a promise in costume

rules.note: the token's price in any form; the disclaimer sentence is allowed (see allowed)
pump.fun as a venue name is allowed (see allowed)
a price floor; the rule's $1 spend floor and the floor() function are allowed (see allowed)
narrow on purpose: 'Debt to the Penny' is data
the only future tense allowed is the rule's own ('on each day with units the keeper spends…'); write what the rule does, not what will happen

rules.pattern: \b(buy|ape|grab|load up|get in|get some|fill your bags?|bag)( now| in| before| the dip| this| it| some| early)?\b(?! ?back)
rules.note: 'bought back' and 'buyback' are mechanics; 'buy' as a verb aimed at the reader is a call

rules.pattern: \b(don'?t miss|last chance|hurry|act now|before it'?s too late|limited time|only \d+ (left|spots?))\b

rules.note: three or more exclamation marks on one line, together or apart
rocket, fire, moons, money bag, flying money, chart up, gem, 100, money face, eyes; the thread emoji 🧵 is fine

allowed.pattern: the rule says what supply does, not what price does

allowed.note: the short disclaimer the T-templates carry

allowed.pattern: \b(not|never|nor)( what)?( a| the| its| the token'?s)? prices?( does)?\b
allowed.note: saying what we do not do

allowed.pattern: burning supply does not make a price go up

allowed.note: the rule's $1 spend floor and the floor() function
debt figures and SOL/USD amounts are data
a statement of Treasury's schedule, not a promise
